_summary: Declares the small Documentation project pack that proves the PeerFoil workflow is not tied to source code.
name: Documentation
summary: A small pack for Markdown documents such as guides, references, and articles. It uses link, source, readability, and editorial checks as evidence and keeps the same independent review path as software.

artifacts.name: Outline
artifacts.description: The audience, purpose, and section plan for the document.

artifacts.name: Examples
artifacts.description: Worked examples, commands, or figures the document relies on.

artifacts.name: Diagrams
artifacts.description: Diagrams with a nearby text explanation of the same relationship or sequence.

evidence.name: link-check
evidence.description: Every relative link resolves and every external link is reachable or marked as unverified.

evidence.name: source-check
evidence.description: Every factual claim, quotation, and figure has a source that says what the document says it says.

evidence.name: readability-review
evidence.description: The text matches its intended reading level and defines terms where they first appear.

evidence.name: editorial-review
evidence.description: A person reads the document for accuracy, clarity, and tone and records the result.

evidence.name: render-check
evidence.description: The rendered output displays headings, tables, code, and diagrams correctly.

review_lenses.name: Accuracy and sources
review_lenses.focus: Claims are supported, current, and cited; examples work as written.

review_lenses.name: Clarity and audience
review_lenses.focus: Structure, reading level, terminology, and examples fit the intended reader.

review_lenses.name: Accessibility and structure
review_lenses.focus: Meaningful headings, descriptive links, text alternatives for diagrams, and readable tables.

review_lenses.name: Licensing and publishing
review_lenses.focus: Attribution, license notices, quoted material, and readiness to publish.

completion: Every required evidence item for the phase has a current record.
Both phase reviewers approved, or the user accepted a recorded reduced-assurance decision.
The plan revision reflects every accepted change and deferral.
The document can be read from start to finish without an unresolved placeholder.

tools.name: git
tools.purpose: Version history for the document and the PeerFoil records.
